# Focal

Focal is an AI-powered SaaS tool that allows users to connect their database and chat with it in plain English.
Users can ask questions like "What items sold the most in the last 3 months?" and get instant answers, charts, and insights without needing any SQL knowledge.

## Core Features
1. Instant Database Connection: Connect standard databases like Supabase in 2 clicks.
2. Plain English Queries: No specialized languages needed to ask questions.
3. Automatic Chart Generation: Instant visual insights rendering directly in the chat interface.

## App Info
- Name: tambo
- Description: Chat with your database. No SQL needed.
- Creator: Divyansh Tiwari
- Built for: Founders, indie hackers, and non-technical teams who need quick data insights.
